features.name: priors_log_intensity
features.description: Log-scaled prior count emphasizing the smooth gradient between zero, few, and many priors; well-suited for linear margin.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth monotonic feature compresses heavy-tailed priors_count for a stable linear coefficient.

features.name: juvenile_total_severity
features.description: Weighted composite of juvenile felony, misdemeanor, and other counts with felony weighted most.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite reduces collinearity among 3 small juvenile counters for cleaner linear weights.

features.name: age_inverse_risk
features.description: Inverse age proxy; younger offenders score higher on this smooth descending curve.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous nonlinear age transform usable as a linear margin contributor.

features.name: age_centered_z
features.description: Standardized centered age using training mean and std for linear projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centered scaled numeric feature improves SVM margin geometry.

features.name: decile_score_norm
features.description: Normalized COMPAS decile score to a 0-1 continuous risk gradient.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth continuous risk axis; ideal feature for linear separation.

features.name: v_decile_score_norm
features.description: Normalized violent decile score to a continuous 0-1 axis.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth secondary risk gradient complementing the general decile score.

features.name: combined_risk_projection
features.description: Average of normalized general and violent decile risk scores.
features.expected_model_benefit: Averaged composite reduces noise and provides a stronger linear projection.

features.name: score_text_severity_ratio
features.description: Continuous severity ratio derived from score_text and v_score_text categories.
features.expected_model_benefit: Averaged ordinal severity provides smooth linear input.

features.name: screening_delay_abs_log
features.description: Absolute days between arrest and screening, log-scaled to dampen extreme tails.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tail-compressed magnitude makes the variable usable as a linear margin contributor.

features.name: compas_days_log
features.description: Log-scaled days from COMPAS event to dampen long-tail distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth heavy-tail compression improves linear separability.

features.name: priors_per_adult_year
features.description: Prior count normalized by years lived since legal adulthood; a per-year intensity ratio.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio captures intensity per exposure year, providing a smooth normalized score.

features.name: charge_severity_judgment
features.description: Semantic ordinal mapping of c_charge_degree into a severity score reflecting typical legal hierarchy of charge degrees (encoded categories ordered by approximate severity).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity proxy from a high-cardinality categorical, usable as a single linear coefficient instead of many one-hot dummies.
